title: A Text Classification Pipeline
learning_objectives: Build a TfidfVectorizer + LogisticRegression pipeline for raw text
Use word bigrams and sublinear term frequency
Read the most informative words from the model's coefficients
hints: Validate `len(texts) == len(labels)` and `len(set(labels)) >= 2`, then build and fit the pipeline.
`order = np.argsort(weights)`: the last n reversed are positive, the first n are negative.

failure_feedback.advice: Fit a Pipeline of TfidfVectorizer and LogisticRegression on the raw texts.
Use ngram_range=(1, 2), sublinear_tf=True and the given C.
Positive coefficients point to class 1; sort coef_[0].
Require matching lengths and at least two classes.
